title: Certify shared reverse centre phase with a charged precision guard
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This conditional interface certificate completes the reverse centre phase complementary to PR1708. For two disjoint 112-row panels sharing the same eight **post-A sinks** and corresponding exact native operators/charts, gathering both panels before each return preserves the signed persistent endpoint and returns the same eight arbitrary-input scratch rows to zero. It reduces the literal reverse-phase bill from 416 to 384 macros: 16→8 rank-8 children, 368→360 ADDs, and 32→16 CLEARs. All 352 panel reads remain charged.

The positive gather envelope doubles from 11/2 to 11. The written exact linear-prefix argument includes unchanged child-private dirt; one extra magnitude bit covers this local envelope comparison. Every fused primitive is therefore conservatively priced at mu+1, with additional preparation/routing/restoration/ownership/hosting overhead DeltaH. A saving requires 8 R8(mu+1)+360 ADD(mu+1)+16 CLEAR(mu+1)+DeltaH < 16 R8(mu)+368 ADD(mu)+32 CLEAR(mu). No native tariff, eligible selected-call pair, full-call recurrence or new kappa is admitted. CLEAR makes the full scratch map singular; the adjoint statement concerns the persistent block.

## Task and overlap

Base: 0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea. Revision-3 card: centre-path-sharing; nonce 1e94dbbfba8c1dc58dbab4dcba380ae3; scope key 184695337cedab03152e/selected-eight-centers/backward-two-panel-shared-return/weighted-guard. Scope is refined because [PR1708](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1708), head 4d163c04c0980c5b0e9092fbd5864c7cfadc125d, already covers the forward fanout. This adds the selected backward event binding and precision-sensitive invoice, without claiming new generic batching algebra. [PR751](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/751) and [PR830](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/830) are credited predecessors; their exact heads are in TASK.json.

[Claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1516#discussioncomment-18919192). Final overlap search covered 419 open PR bodies including drafts and 873 local records; relevant Discussions were read directly. Numbered pages are non-atomic, and no complete Discussion census or novelty certificate is claimed. Current main and PR1708's head were rechecked before submission.

## Validation

Run:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/centre-shared-return-guard
```

Python 3.12.14, macOS arm64: registered replay passes, all 480 complex basis inputs match an independent closed-form endpoint, and seven semantic fault witnesses fail as required. Eight phase-bearing two-coordinate Gaussian unitary representatives exercise the abstract inverse-adjoint interface; this is not an actual 512-dimensional operator replay. Exact coefficients and all eight reverse blocks are pinned to selected-replay.tar.gz. Written linearity handles arbitrary exact common operators under the stated hypotheses.

All 18 repository onboarding tests pass. Standalone exports pass normally and under -O; input/receipt corruption and occupied-output controls reject safely. VALIDATION.json records evidence and limitations. No full frontier replay, Lean, native rounded precision theorem or hosting admission was run. Selected record and frozen sources are unchanged.

Generic adjoint/batching algebra is prior work. Prepared by @ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, implementation, bounded independent review, tests and writing. Apache-2.0; original notices retained. No independent human review.

## Open next questions

[README next questions](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ea14f191752c9901bf6684763534d2d248fb2ad2/research/centre-shared-return-guard/README.md#open-next-questions): trace one actual caller pair to prove common post-A sinks, charts and uninterrupted ownership, then instantiate the native precision/tape prices and DeltaH. Those are blockers to a complete-call or frontier improvement. No merge or frontier update is requested.
